subject.title: fix(feishu): preserve text when replies include media

question: Should this PR remain the narrow canonical fix for the active-streaming text-plus-media failure after successful live proof, or should the broader open implementation in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102397 be selected and narrowed instead?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same canonical bug, but the broader branch covers additional failure modes and neither supplied record establishes it as a safe replacement; selecting a landing direction requires owner judgment beyond the available proof.

options.title: Retain the narrow fix and require proof

options.title: Adopt the broader path
options.body: Use the wider implementation only after its extra startup and block-delivery behavior is independently reviewed and proven, then close or supersede this branch deliberately.
